user.title: CozyLife Local
user.description: Discover switches on the LAN or add one by IP.

discover.title: Select CozyLife devices
discover.description: Devices that answered UDP discovery on port 6095.

channels.title: Channels per device
channels.description: Multi-gang wall switches use DPID 1 as a bitmask. Set channels to the number of rockers (2, 3, 4...). Single plugs stay at 1.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device on TCP 5555.
error.no_devices: No devices answered UDP discovery. Check VLAN / client isolation, then retry or use manual IP.

init.title: Channel count
init.description: Set how many rockers each multi-gang switch has. DPID 1 is a bitmask (bit0=channel1, bit1=channel2, ...).
